Cc: finance-ops@acmehealth.com
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Initial: billing allocation for multi-entity contract (PO AC-993)

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked us to confirm how Redwood plans to route invoices for PO AC-993 — the purchase needs to be split across our UK and US cost centers for accounting and VAT reasons.

High-level requirements from our side:
- Invoice lines should be split by cost-center code (UK: CC-EMEA-01; US: CC-US-14).
- VAT must be applied at the UK rate for the EMEA portion; US portion should be VAT-exempt.
- Each legal-entity invoice needs legally-complete tax fields (VAT reg no., billing address, invoice numbering).
- We need a single consolidated remittance advice to match to the PO, or two separate invoices if Redwood requires entity-level invoicing.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
1) Emit two invoices (Redwood, Redwood EMEA) tied to the same PO, with a shared remittance reference?
2) Alternatively, provide one invoice with line-level entity tags so our AP system can auto-allocate?

Attached is our PO and the cost-center mapping. If you need a quick call with our tax lead, we can schedule.

Regards,
Elena
Elena Kovacs
Head of Procurement, Acme Health Systems

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Initial: billing allocation for multi-entity contract (PO AC-993)

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear breakdown. We can support both patterns but there are accounting and operational trade-offs. Quick answers first:

- Yes, we can issue two legal-entity invoices (Redwood Inc. + Redwood EMEA Ltd.) that reference the same PO and include a shared remittance reference.
- We can also deliver a single invoice with line-level entity tags, but some ERPs (including yours) prefer entity-level invoices for tax posting.

I've attached a proposed split schedule (CSV) with the line-by-line allocations I recommend based on the PO. Priyom (billing) and Neha (tax/compliance) are cc'd to confirm VAT fields and numbering.

Next steps I propose:
1) Priyom to confirm the invoice numbering scheme and whether we should issue two separate invoice numbers or one with sub-line references.
2) Neha to confirm VAT registration numbers for Redwood EMEA and confirm wording for VAT-exempt US lines.
3) Elena to confirm whether Acme needs separate remittance instructions or if a consolidated remittance reference is sufficient.

If helpful I can send a sample PDF of the two-invoice flow for review.

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Rishi / Elena — I reviewed the CSV. A few notes from billing ops:

- We can issue two invoices. Operationally we prefer separate invoice numbers per legal entity (e.g., RWI-2026-1001 and RWI-EMEA-2026-0456) to keep ledgers clean.
- For a consolidated remittance, we will include a single \"Remittance Reference\" field on both invoices with the PO number and a shared allocation token (e.g., AC-993/REM-7821). That lets Acme's AP match a single payment to both invoices.
- Payment terms: will match the PO (Net 30). If Acme intends to pay only one invoice and leave the other outstanding, we will need a credit/offset process documented.

Question for Acme: do you require separate PDF files per invoice in the same DocuSign envelope, or can we bundle both PDFs into a single envelope? Procurement portals differ.

I'll follow up after Neha confirms VAT text and registration numbers.

—Priyom
